podcast.body: Duran Duran wrote the "bones" of the theme song for the 1985 James Bond film "A View to a Kill," with John Barry later arranging it for a 60-piece orchestra. This theme became the only Bond song to reach number one on the American singles charts and was one of Duran Duran's biggest hits overall, bringing a new wave sound to the franchise. "Durand Durand came up with the bones of the song and John Berry took it from there using a 60 piece orchestra."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This theme song for the 1985 James Bond film *A View to a Kill* was recorded by Duran Duran. It holds the unique distinction of being the only James Bond theme in the franchise's 60-year history to reach number one on the Hot 100. "The British Synth Pop was now so well regarded by high pop culture that Durand Durand were tapped by the James Bond franchise to record the theme to 1985's A View to a Kill."
